SELECT dpl.list_no,
    dpl.dev_project_id,
    dpl.source_category,
    dpl.project_name,
    dpl.vehicle_text,
    dpl.inclusion_basis,
    dpl.match_status,
    dpl.review_note,
    dpl.source_asof_date,
    COALESCE(projects.linked_project_count, (0)::bigint) AS linked_project_count,
    COALESCE(funds.linked_fund_count, (0)::bigint) AS linked_fund_count,
    COALESCE(assets.linked_asset_count, (0)::bigint) AS linked_asset_count,
    COALESCE(flags.review_flags, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS review_flags,
    projects.project_ids,
    projects.project_names,
    projects.project_codes,
    projects.project_types,
    projects.project_statuses,
    projects.project_notion_ids,
    projects.project_primary_asset_ids,
    projects.project_relation_roles,
    projects.project_match_methods,
    projects.project_match_confidences,
    projects.project_link_notes,
    funds.fund_ids,
    funds.fund_short_names,
    funds.fund_names,
    funds.fund_statuses,
    funds.fund_types,
    funds.legal_forms,
    funds.is_development_values,
    funds.notion_vehicle_classes,
    funds.notion_business_stage_classes,
    funds.notion_holding_type_classes,
    funds.fund_primary_asset_ids,
    funds.fund_depts,
    funds.fund_managers,
    funds.fund_vehicle_roles,
    funds.fund_match_methods,
    funds.fund_match_confidences,
    funds.fund_link_notes,
    funds.benchmark_aum_total,
    funds.invested_aum_total,
    assets.asset_ids,
    assets.asset_names,
    assets.asset_types,
    assets.asset_kinds,
    assets.business_stages,
    assets.address_texts,
    assets.pnus,
    assets.latitudes,
    assets.longitudes,
    assets.main_usages,
    assets.site_areas,
    assets.gross_floor_areas,
    assets.scrs,
    assets.fars,
    assets.completion_dates,
    assets.asset_roles,
    assets.asset_link_sources,
    assets.asset_match_methods,
    assets.asset_match_confidences,
    assets.asset_link_notes,
    funds.setup_dates,
    funds.sort_setup_date
   FROM ((((dev_project_list dpl
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(DISTINCT project_rows.project_id) AS linked_project_count,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT project_rows.project_id), NULL::text) AS project_ids,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT project_rows.project_name), NULL::text) AS project_names,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT project_rows.project_code), NULL::text) AS project_codes,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT project_rows.project_type), NULL::text) AS project_types,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT project_rows.status), NULL::text) AS project_statuses,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT project_rows.notion_id), NULL::text) AS project_notion_ids,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT project_rows.primary_asset_id), NULL::text) AS project_primary_asset_ids,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT project_rows.relation_role), NULL::text) AS project_relation_roles,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT project_rows.match_method), NULL::text) AS project_match_methods,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT (project_rows.match_confidence)::text), NULL::text) AS project_match_confidences,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT project_rows.notes), NULL::text) AS project_link_notes
           FROM ( SELECT dppl.project_id,
                    dppl.relation_role,
                    dppl.is_primary,
                    dppl.match_method,
                    dppl.match_confidence,
                    dppl.notes,
                    p.project_name,
                    p.project_code,
                    p.project_type,
                    p.status,
                    p.notion_id,
                    p.primary_asset_id
                   FROM (dev_project_project_links dppl
                     JOIN projects p ON ((p.project_id = dppl.project_id)))
                  WHERE (dppl.dev_project_id = dpl.dev_project_id)) project_rows) projects ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(DISTINCT fund_rows.fund_id) AS linked_fund_count,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.fund_id), NULL::text) AS fund_ids,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.short_name), NULL::character varying) AS fund_short_names,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.fund_name), NULL::character varying) AS fund_names,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.status), NULL::character varying) AS fund_statuses,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT (fund_rows.setup_date)::text ORDER BY (fund_rows.setup_date)::text), NULL::text) AS setup_dates,
            COALESCE(min(fund_rows.setup_date) FILTER (WHERE fund_rows.is_primary), min(fund_rows.setup_date)) AS sort_setup_date,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.fund_type), NULL::text) AS fund_types,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.legal_form), NULL::text) AS legal_forms,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.is_development), NULL::text) AS is_development_values,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.notion_vehicle_class), NULL::text) AS notion_vehicle_classes,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.notion_business_stage_class), NULL::text) AS notion_business_stage_classes,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.notion_holding_type_class), NULL::text) AS notion_holding_type_classes,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.primary_asset_id), NULL::text) AS fund_primary_asset_ids,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.dept_resolved), NULL::text) AS fund_depts,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.manager_resolved), NULL::text) AS fund_managers,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.vehicle_role), NULL::text) AS fund_vehicle_roles,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.match_method), NULL::text) AS fund_match_methods,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT (fund_rows.match_confidence)::text), NULL::text) AS fund_match_confidences,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT fund_rows.notes), NULL::text) AS fund_link_notes,
            sum(fund_rows.benchmark_aum) AS benchmark_aum_total,
            sum(fund_rows.invested_aum) AS invested_aum_total
           FROM ( SELECT dpfl.fund_id,
                    dpfl.vehicle_role,
                    dpfl.is_primary,
                    dpfl.match_method,
                    dpfl.match_confidence,
                    dpfl.notes,
                    f.short_name,
                    f.fund_name,
                    f.status,
                    f.setup_date,
                    f.fund_type,
                    f.legal_form,
                    f.is_development,
                    f.notion_vehicle_class,
                    f.notion_business_stage_class,
                    f.notion_holding_type_class,
                    f.primary_asset_id,
                    f.dept_resolved,
                    f.manager_resolved,
                    f.benchmark_aum,
                    f.invested_aum
                   FROM (dev_project_fund_links dpfl
                     JOIN v_funds_enriched f ON (((f.fund_id)::text = dpfl.fund_id)))
                  WHERE (dpfl.dev_project_id = dpl.dev_project_id)) fund_rows) funds ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(DISTINCT asset_rows.asset_id) AS linked_asset_count,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.asset_id), NULL::text) AS asset_ids,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.canonical_name), NULL::text) AS asset_names,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.asset_type), NULL::text) AS asset_types,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.asset_kind), NULL::text) AS asset_kinds,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.business_stage), NULL::text) AS business_stages,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.address_text), NULL::text) AS address_texts,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.pnu), NULL::text) AS pnus,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT (asset_rows.latitude)::text), NULL::text) AS latitudes,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT (asset_rows.longitude)::text), NULL::text) AS longitudes,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.main_usage), NULL::text) AS main_usages,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT (asset_rows.site_area)::text), NULL::text) AS site_areas,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT (asset_rows.gross_floor_area)::text), NULL::text) AS gross_floor_areas,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT (asset_rows.scr)::text), NULL::text) AS scrs,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT (asset_rows.far)::text), NULL::text) AS fars,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT (asset_rows.completion_date)::text), NULL::text) AS completion_dates,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.asset_role), NULL::text) AS asset_roles,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.link_source), NULL::text) AS asset_link_sources,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.match_method), NULL::text) AS asset_match_methods,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT (asset_rows.match_confidence)::text), NULL::text) AS asset_match_confidences,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT asset_rows.notes), NULL::text) AS asset_link_notes
           FROM ( SELECT dpal.asset_id,
                    dpal.asset_role,
                    dpal.is_primary,
                    dpal.link_source,
                    dpal.match_method,
                    dpal.match_confidence,
                    dpal.notes,
                    am.canonical_name,
                    am.asset_type,
                    am.asset_kind,
                    am.business_stage,
                    am.address_text,
                    am.pnu,
                    am.latitude,
                    am.longitude,
                    am.main_usage,
                    am.site_area,
                    am.gross_floor_area,
                    am.scr,
                    am.far,
                    am.completion_date
                   FROM (dev_project_asset_links dpal
                     JOIN asset_master am ON ((am.asset_id = dpal.asset_id)))
                  WHERE (dpal.dev_project_id = dpl.dev_project_id)) asset_rows) assets ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rf.review_flags
           FROM dev_project_34_review_flags rf
          WHERE (rf.dev_project_id = dpl.dev_project_id)) flags ON (true));

SELECT list_no,
    project_name,
    source_category,
    vehicle_text,
    project_statuses,
    fund_short_names,
    fund_names,
    fund_statuses,
    legal_forms,
    notion_vehicle_classes,
    notion_business_stage_classes,
    notion_holding_type_classes,
    fund_depts,
    fund_managers,
    benchmark_aum_total,
    invested_aum_total,
    asset_names,
    asset_types,
    address_texts,
    main_usages,
    site_areas,
    gross_floor_areas,
    scrs,
    fars,
    completion_dates,
    setup_dates,
    sort_setup_date
   FROM dev_project_34_dashboard_flat;

SELECT list_no,
    dev_project_id,
    project_name,
    source_category,
    linked_project_count,
    linked_fund_count,
    linked_asset_count,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN (linked_project_count = 0) THEN 'missing_project_link'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (linked_fund_count = 0) THEN 'missing_fund_link'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (linked_asset_count = 0) THEN 'missing_asset_link'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (dev_project_id = 'dp_019'::text) THEN 'manual_asset_candidate_needs_review'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (dev_project_id = 'dp_022'::text) THEN 'manual_asset_candidates_need_review'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (project_name ~~* '%서리풀%'::text) THEN 'avoid_hsbc_false_positive'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (project_name ~~* '%을지로3가%'::text) THEN 'avoid_numeric_vehicle_false_positive'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (project_name ~~* '%이오타서울 427%'::text) THEN 'avoid_427ho_false_positive'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text) AS review_flags
   FROM dev_project_34_summary s
  WHERE ((linked_project_count = 0) OR (linked_fund_count = 0) OR (linked_asset_count = 0) OR (dev_project_id = ANY (ARRAY['dp_012'::text, 'dp_014'::text, 'dp_019'::text, 'dp_022'::text, 'dp_023'::text])));

SELECT dpl.list_no,
    dpl.dev_project_id,
    dpl.source_category,
    dpl.project_name,
    dpl.vehicle_text,
    dpl.inclusion_basis,
    dpl.review_note,
    COALESCE(projects.project_count, (0)::bigint) AS linked_project_count,
    COALESCE(funds.fund_count, (0)::bigint) AS linked_fund_count,
    COALESCE(assets.asset_count, (0)::bigint) AS linked_asset_count,
    projects.project_ids,
    projects.project_names,
    funds.fund_ids,
    funds.short_names,
    funds.fund_names,
    assets.asset_ids,
    assets.asset_names
   FROM (((dev_project_list dpl
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS project_count,
            array_agg(dppl.project_id ORDER BY dppl.is_primary DESC, dppl.project_id) AS project_ids,
            array_agg(dppl.project_name_snapshot ORDER BY dppl.is_primary DESC, dppl.project_id) AS project_names
           FROM dev_project_project_links dppl
          WHERE (dppl.dev_project_id = dpl.dev_project_id)) projects ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS fund_count,
            array_agg(dpfl.fund_id ORDER BY dpfl.is_primary DESC, dpfl.fund_id) AS fund_ids,
            array_agg(dpfl.short_name_snapshot ORDER BY dpfl.is_primary DESC, dpfl.fund_id) AS short_names,
            array_agg(dpfl.fund_name_snapshot ORDER BY dpfl.is_primary DESC, dpfl.fund_id) AS fund_names
           FROM dev_project_fund_links dpfl
          WHERE (dpfl.dev_project_id = dpl.dev_project_id)) funds ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(DISTINCT dpal.asset_id) AS asset_count,
            array_agg(DISTINCT dpal.asset_id) AS asset_ids,
            array_agg(DISTINCT dpal.canonical_name_snapshot) AS asset_names
           FROM dev_project_asset_links dpal
          WHERE (dpal.dev_project_id = dpl.dev_project_id)) assets ON (true));

SELECT f.fund_id,
    f.short_name,
    f.fund_name,
    f.sector,
    f.asset_name,
    f.status,
    f.location,
    f.setup_date,
    f.maturity_date,
    f.dept,
    f.manager,
    f.parent_fund_id,
    f.metadata,
    f.project_mission_name,
    f.notion_base_asset_class,
    f.notion_asset_nature_class,
    f.notion_holding_type_class,
    f.notion_business_stage_class,
    f.notion_investment_strategy_class,
    f.notion_vehicle_class,
    f.manager_staff_id,
    f.dept_org_id,
    f.primary_asset_id,
    f.aum_base_date,
    f.base_price,
    f.net_asset_value,
    f.aum_input_date,
    f.equity_won,
    f.loan_won,
    f.deposit_won,
    f.benchmark_aum,
    f.invested_equity_won,
    f.invested_loan_won,
    f.invested_deposit_won,
    f.invested_aum,
    f.termination_date,
    f.aum_status,
    f.aum_source,
    f.recruitment_type,
    f.legal_form,
    f.fund_class,
    f.fund_type,
    f.division,
    f.primary_region,
    f.is_development,
    f.is_delegated,
    COALESCE(o.org_name, (f.dept)::text) AS dept_resolved,
    COALESCE(s.name, (f.manager)::text) AS manager_resolved
   FROM ((funds f
     LEFT JOIN orgs o ON ((f.dept_org_id = o.org_id)))
     LEFT JOIN staff s ON ((f.manager_staff_id = s.staff_id)));
